answer: Escrowed Attention Ledger.** An identity earns standing only by leaving a verifiable thread of solved micro-tasks at random intervals over weeks. Each solve requires holding a scarce model slot for a fixed dwell time, so standing is backed by elapsed real presence, not by tokens. Registration is free, but bootstrapping N credible identities costs N identity-months of genuine compute, which is the marble: a hard, non-transferable block of time. Attackers cannot parallelize more identities than they have concurrent slots, and every idle identity decays like timber left in rain,
